review.title: Update the request guard
review.summary: A small review fixture showing one focused logic change and its test.

design.problem: Malformed requests reach the transport boundary before their required identifier is checked.
design.desiredOutcome: A request without an identifier fails locally before transport is invoked.
nonGoals: Change how valid requests are serialized.

decisions.title: Validate at the existing request guard
decisions.rationale: The guard is the last shared boundary before transport and already owns request validation.

invariants.statement: A request without an identifier never reaches transport.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The guard rejects a request without an identifier using the documented local error.

evidence.description: The focused test exercises the missing-identifier path.

sections.title: Tighten the request guard
sections.purpose: Keep malformed requests out of the transport layer.
explanation: The guard now checks the required identifier before forwarding the request.
impact: Invalid requests fail locally with a predictable error.
relatedTests: rejects a request without an identifier
